definition_of_done: >
  1. packages/providers holds the provider contract (models, complete, with fetch injected and
  an abort signal), the request and answer model, the catalogue format with source and date,
  the failure states and their mapping rules, the context assembly from a kernel for a passage,
  a unit and the project, the preview whose total equals the size of what is sent, and a fake
  provider with deterministic answers and programmable failures; packages/providers-claude
  implements the contract on the Claude provider's Messages API with a dated catalogue that
  names its source, with request and response fixtures recorded as the API documents them;
  packages/assistant holds the ask action: call record created before the request leaves,
  answer object proposed and anchored to the scope with the record as dependency, failures and
  cancellation written into the record and nothing else created. None of the three packages
  imports a Node or DOM module. 2. The tests TST-PRV-002a, 002b, 003a, 003b, 004b, 005a, 005b,
  006a, 006b, 007a, 007b and TST-AST-001b exist under their names and pass; TST-PRV-007b is
  skipped and reported as not verified when no key is in the environment. 3. Every figure of
  the catalogue carries its source and date; no price is written without them. 4. REPORT.md
  opens with the result against this definition and names each requirement with the tests
  that prove it, and states which tests of each requirement remain for ENG-0006.
